sanskrit: grāhyā dūto 'sy ulūkā saṃ pacāmi te ||
english: You are the messenger of the Seizure, O owl — I cook you up together.

sanskrit: nirṛtyā dūto 'sy ulūkā saṃ pacāmi te ||
english: You are the messenger of Dissolution, O owl — I cook you up together.

sanskrit: varuṇasya dūto 'sy ulūkā saṃ pacāmi te ||
english: You are the messenger of Varuṇa, O owl — I cook you up together.

sanskrit: mṛtyor dūto 'sy ulūkā saṃ pacāmi te ||
english: You are the messenger of Death, O owl — I cook you up together.

sanskrit: yamasya dūto 'sy ulūkā saṃ pacāmi te ||
english: You are the messenger of Yama, O owl — I cook you up together.

sanskrit: rājā tvā varuṇo 'khanad dattāṃ somena babhruṇā | tāṃ tvā vidma pratāpikāṃ prāmuṣya hṛdayaṃ tapa ||
english: King Varuṇa dug you up, given over by tawny Soma; we know you as the scorching one — having snatched away his heart, burn it.

sanskrit: śocayainaṃ pratapainaṃ sam enaṃ takmanā sṛja | yathāsya dahyamānasy- -āgniḥ parvāṇy anv ayad | hṛdayaṃ prevalijjayād akṣyau kāmena śocayān muhūrtaṃ mām apaśyataḥ ||
english: Make him grieve, scorch him, afflict him together with fever — just as fire overtook the joints of one burning, so let it lick up his heart; make his eyes blaze with longing for the one who has not looked upon me even for a moment.

sanskrit: ayam it tvāgnir ā nayād vātas tvāta ud yamāt | yaṃ tvam enaṃ ni vartay- -āsau hā iha te manaḥ ||
english: This very fire shall bring you here; the wind shall lift you up from there toward Yama — him whom you would turn away: alas, his mind is here, is yours.

sanskrit: agniṣ ṭvā tapatu sūryas tvā tapatu vātas tvā yuṅktāṃ marutaś ca yuñjatām | arvāṅ ehi samaṭamāno marīcibhiḥ ||
english: May Agni scorch you, may the Sun scorch you, may the Wind yoke you and the Maruts yoke you as well — come hither, scorched through and through by rays of light.

sanskrit: vṛhāmi te lomāny aṅgebhyaḥ pacāmi māṃsaṃ jvalayāmy asthi | iha te ramatāṃ mano mayi te ramatāṃ manaḥ ||
english: I tear the hairs from your limbs, I cook your flesh, I set your bones ablaze — let your mind find delight here, let your mind find delight in me.

sanskrit: ayaṃ piṇḍaḥ karkarapiṇḍaḥ smaraḥ pāñcalaḥ saṃtapanaḥ karaṃkaraḥ | amuṣya hṛdayaṃ tapo yam ahaṃ kāmaye priyam ||
english: This ball, this crunching ball — Smara, the Pāñcāla, the Scorcher, the Clattering One — burn the heart of that dear one whom I desire.

sanskrit: yathāyam agnis tapati yathā tapati sūryaḥ | evā te tapyatāṃ mano hṛdayam aṅgamaṅgaṃ paruṣparur māṃ kāmena na ramāsā atra ||
english: As this fire burns, as the Sun burns — so let your mind burn, your heart, limb by limb and joint by joint; you shall not find rest here unless longing for me.

sanskrit: yathā tapati paraśuṃ yathā vāsinakhādanam | yathā sūrya udyan sarvaṃ saṃtapati | evā te tapyatāṃ mano hṛdayam aṅgamaṅgaṃ paruṣparur māṃ kāmena na ramāsā atra ||
english: As fire heats an axe, as it heats the adze that gnaws wood, as the rising Sun scorches everything — so let your mind burn, your heart, limb by limb and joint by joint; you shall not find rest here unless longing for me.

sanskrit: saṃ tvā dyauś ca pṛthivī ca tapatāṃ māṃ kāmena na ramāsā atra ||
english: May Heaven and Earth scorch you together — you shall not find rest here unless longing for me.

sanskrit: smara hai smaratād amum aṅgajvareṇocchocanīnām | takmanainaṃ saṃ sṛja viśvaśāradena mama kāmena ||
english: Remember! Let him remember her who inflames with fever of the limbs — afflict him with fever, the perennial fever, with longing for me.

sanskrit: aṣṭāśītiṃ sahasrāṇy aty avādīd vaco mama | ihāre 'ham avādiṣam atrāre prāyasy astam ||
english: Eighty-eight thousand times he has spoken past my word; I spoke here, afar — there afar you are going to your setting.

sanskrit: yaṃ sumitraḥ sumitrāyai cakre 'vāsā smaram | yathā sā tasya kāmena na suṣvāpa kadā cana | evāsau mama kāmena māva svāpsīt kadā cana ||
english: The love-spell that Sumitra worked for Sumitrā, stripping her of garments — just as she never once slept soundly for longing of him — so too let that one never once sleep soundly for longing of me.

sanskrit: pary agnir āpas tapati pari dyām eti sūryaḥ | pari tvām indro vṛtrahā mahyaṃ tapatu sarvataḥ ||
english: Fire scorches the waters all around; the Sun traverses the sky all around — may Indra the Vṛtra-slayer scorch you all around on my behalf.

sanskrit: yathā vāto nyāvāti yathā tapati sūryaḥ | evā tvam indra vṛtrahann amuṃ mahyam ihā naya ||
english: As the wind blows down, as the Sun burns — even so, O Indra Vṛtra-slayer, bring that one here to me.

sanskrit: śālālavaṃ saṃvananaṃ vanād vananam ābhṛtam | yena gayo gandharvo apsarasāṃ samavānayat | tenāham amuṃ mayi vānayāmy ā mṛtyor ā parāvataḥ ||
english: The śālālava plant, the alluring one, brought from forest to forest — by which Gaya the Gandharva drew the Apsarases to himself — by that same I draw that one to me, from the range of Death, from the farthest distance.
